description: Controlled analyzer regression cases plus exploratory archived Linux v6.6.87 e1000e translation units. No real-kernel case is labeled ground truth.

cases.expected_behavior: A potentially feasible process-context lock-order cycle exists for opposite_a and opposite_b.
cases.rationale: Two controlled functions acquire the same two locks in opposite orders.
cases.validation_method: Run current analyzer and assert a matching cycle/category in its JSON report.
cases.known_limitations: A static candidate does not establish scheduling, lock ownership, or a runtime deadlock.

cases.expected_behavior: The registered hardirq handler and process path produce an interrupt-aware candidate.
cases.rationale: Exercises request_irq target resolution and process-to-hardirq lock relationships.
cases.validation_method: Run current analyzer and inspect cycle provenance and registration data.
cases.known_limitations: Source registration does not prove registration execution or actual interrupt delivery.

cases.expected_behavior: The exclusive_a/exclusive_b graph shape is rejected by compatible-path feasibility checks.
cases.rationale: Opposite lock acquisitions are guarded by contradictory supported predicates.
cases.validation_method: Run current analyzer and require rejected feasibility plus contradictory predicate evidence.
cases.known_limitations: Only the documented bounded subset of branch predicates is supported.

cases.expected_behavior: No dependency state_a to state_b is inferred across the release.
cases.rationale: A release terminates the held-lock interval before the next acquisition.
cases.validation_method: Run analyzer and inspect directed dependency edges.
cases.known_limitations: This is a narrow controlled negative, not a general proof of release semantics.

cases.expected_behavior: Macro-expanded irqsave acquisition and irqrestore release are recognized with saved-state evidence.
cases.rationale: Exercises macro expansion location handling and state-variable recovery.
cases.validation_method: Run analyzer and check operation API, kind, lock identity and state metadata.
cases.known_limitations: The fixture models a small wrapper and does not replace validation against all kernel configurations.

cases.expected_behavior: The irqsave acquire and irqrestore release in irqsave_protects_handler_path refer to the same lock and saved-state identity.
cases.rationale: Checks that irqrestore is associated with saved state instead of treated as unconditional enable.
cases.validation_method: Run analyzer and compare acquire/release lock and saved-state identities.
cases.known_limitations: The fixture does not establish initial hardware IRQ state on all execution paths.

cases.expected_behavior: The wrapper's irqsave API effect is visible in the extracted operations.
cases.rationale: Exercises the documented wrapper-summary behavior around a locking API.
cases.validation_method: Run analyzer and inspect the API operation and symbolic lock identity.
cases.known_limitations: Only supported direct wrapper propagation is covered.

cases.expected_behavior: Parameter-based lock identities remain symbolic and are substituted through supported call sites.
cases.rationale: Exercises summary reuse and lock identity propagation without merging same-typed objects by name.
cases.validation_method: Run analyzer and inspect symbolic identity/status in operations and dependencies.
cases.known_limitations: General pointer alias analysis is not implemented; unresolved identities remain uncertainty.

cases.expected_behavior: Unlabeled exploratory source-analysis result; report extracted facts and limitations only.
cases.rationale: Largest selected e1000e translation unit; includes irqsave use and pointer-based adapter state.
cases.evidence_source: Phase 15 run measurements and archived analyzer report; provenance and checksums recorded in the Phase 15 artifacts.
cases.validation_method: Read the preserved Phase 15 JSON report from the report archive; rerun from a clean pinned checkout with evaluation/run_kernel_eval.py.
cases.known_limitations: Not independently labeled; unsupported aliasing and incomplete translation-unit call context can affect edges.

cases.expected_behavior: Unlabeled exploratory source-analysis result; report extracted facts and limitations only.
cases.rationale: Representative device-management and ethtool entry points within the same selected driver.
cases.evidence_source: Phase 15 run measurements and archived analyzer report.
cases.validation_method: Read preserved Phase 15 report; rerun with the documented kernel evaluation command.
cases.known_limitations: Not independently labeled; a zero reported cycle count does not prove absence of bugs.

cases.expected_behavior: Unlabeled exploratory source-analysis result; report extracted facts and limitations only.
cases.rationale: Exercises a second driver translation unit with hardware-specific operations.
cases.evidence_source: Phase 15 run measurements and archived analyzer report.
cases.validation_method: Read preserved Phase 15 report; rerun with the documented kernel evaluation command.
cases.known_limitations: Not independently labeled; hardware-specific runtime behavior is not evaluated.

cases.expected_behavior: Unlabeled exploratory source-analysis result; report extracted facts and limitations only.
cases.rationale: Representative PHY configuration code in the selected e1000e subsystem.
cases.evidence_source: Phase 15 run measurements and archived analyzer report.
cases.validation_method: Read preserved Phase 15 report; rerun with the documented kernel evaluation command.
cases.known_limitations: Not independently labeled; no whole-kernel call graph or runtime exercise is available.

cases.expected_behavior: Unlabeled exploratory source-analysis result; report extracted facts and limitations only.
cases.rationale: Small subsystem translation unit used to compare extraction behavior across files.
cases.evidence_source: Phase 15 run measurements and archived analyzer report.
cases.validation_method: Read preserved Phase 15 report; rerun with the documented kernel evaluation command.
cases.known_limitations: Not independently labeled; no whole-kernel call graph or runtime exercise is available.

independent_bug_cases_note: No case is labeled a confirmed Linux deadlock in this dataset. A suitable candidate requires an independently documented report or fix, an affected revision and source location, and evidence that the scenario matches IRQGuard's modeled scope; none has been added without that evidence.
